source.file: Price List For Discovery V1 COB+ Discovery M SMD Series
source.note: Cabinet USD/m² and module USD/pc both go in inventory Cost. Not sell price, not dealer net, not local warehouse cost. Sqm price includes power and receiving card, not a sending card or packaging. Spare modules are separate SKUs. 2-year warranty. Not linked to the website.
